text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to remove an accessible loading zone on Hedge End Road, between a point 74 metres north of Sheppard Avenue East and a point 15 metres further north-east. The accessible permit holder who the loading zone was intended for is no longer at this address and the space is no longer required.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing accessible loading zone that operates at all times on the south and east side of Hedge End Road, between a point 74 metres north of Sheppard Avenue East and a point 15 metres further north-east.
